name: nitto-bounce
text: [excited] [cheerfully] Righto! I got this! Good morning! Overnight, three stations on the Bremer went quiet at ten past two. All of them heard through the same repeater, so it's the repeater worth a look, not the stations. Billy's up! Tea?

name: turbo-notch
text: [quickly] And it was a wet week! Thursday was the wettest, nearly four hundred gauges reporting rain. A wet week is when the stations earn their keep! Personal best! Race ya!
